subject: Support building on Clang / Apple
reason: The change is a build/portability fix to compile valkey-json under Clang/AppleClang: CMake gains arm64 support, Clang warning suppressions, and a Clang-only weak-symbol define; the source edits are warning fixes with no semantic effect (removing std::move on temporaries, friend class->friend struct, naming anonymous typedef'd structs, [[maybe_unused]] attributes, a cast in a unit test, and %lu->%llu / %lx->%llx in log format strings, which on LP64 Linux print identically and touch only log text, never replies or persisted data). On the fuzzer's GCC/Linux build the compiled module is behavioura
